This is a conditional-render branch keyed off the sync status value, not a layout/timing glitch.

This shows the value is computed **once per cold process start** (e.g., in app/ViewModel init), not re-evaluated on each screen visit or re-render.

## Conclusion

The flake is **not** a UI-test timing/animation race. The "Retry sync" button's existence is driven by an in-app sync-status value that is randomized once per process (cold) start — it resolves to "Sync idle" (button rendered) roughly 60–70% of the time and "Sync unavailable" (button and its container omitted entirely) the rest of the time, and then stays fixed for the life of that process. Any UI test asserting the button is visible on Diagnostics will intermittently fail whenever a given test run's cold launch happens to land on the "Sync unavailable" branch — this is a test-target bug (undeterministic initial state), not a test authoring/timing issue. Fix should either seed/mock the sync status deterministically for the test build, or the test should assert on both valid states rather than assuming the button is always present.
